facts.text: Through the Alva Incentive Program, full-time students who establish residency within the Alva city limits receive financial assistance for tuition and housing.

sources.title: Paying For College - Northwestern Oklahoma State University
sources.quote: First-time freshmen and transfer students attending Northwestern-Alva on a full-time basis who establish a residence in the city may be eligible for additional financial assistance through a unique to Northwestern incentive program.

sources.title: Paying For College - Northwestern Oklahoma State University
sources.quote: To qualify for this scholarship money, you'll need to live within the Alva city limits.
